Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re all aligned and can move toward procurement: 

- Decision criteria: primary drivers are latency under 200ms for user-facing flows, data residency in us-east, and predictable per-token pricing for batch billing.
- Key stakeholders: Samantha (Procurement) — PO & vendor onboarding; Tom (Security) — SOC2, data controls; Marta (Engineering lead) — integration and rollout timeline; Economic buyer: CFO (TBD) — budget signoff.
- Procurement asks you mentioned: W-9, standard vendor questionnaire, short SOC2 summary, and our standard SOW + invoice terms.
- Timeline: you indicated a mid-August target for vendor approval and a September pilot start if procurement and security clearances move quickly.

Next steps I propose: 
1) I’ll attach our vendor_onboarding_checklist and a one-page SOC2 summary for Tom.
2) Can you confirm the contact for legal (for redlines) and the PO billing email?
3) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min procurement kickoff this week to walk through the checklist and confirm exact docs needed.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,

- Required vendor docs: completed W-9 (attached once we have a copy), vendor onboarding form (we’ll send the form to you), and proof of insurance.

Timeline we’re targeting: procurement kickoff this Thursday (23 Jul) or Friday morning, PO approval by ~Aug 12, pilot start early September. I’m attaching our vendor onboarding form and an initial W-9 for your records (we’ll attach the signed copy once internal approvals finish).
